title: sos_signature.json: regenerate with real pinned Schnorr48 key + AddrForKey transcript
description: Fixture slice of b7z9.121. test/vectors/sos_signature.json is descriptive-only (placeholder keys); only Rust pins a real transcript digest. Regenerate with a real pinned Ed25519/Schnorr48 keypair, the AddrForKey-derived 16-octet origin IPv6 (post upstream-yggdrasil-addressing), a real canonical-CBOR SOS payload, and real signature bytes so all three stacks verify against the same oracle. Include a silent-drop (error_response:false) invalid-signature case. Independent oracle: sign with the python schnorr48 reference impl, verify vectors with Rust/C - never derive expected bytes from the code under test. Land with the address slices since the transcript covers the origin address.
close_reason: Regenerated test/vectors/sos_signature.json with real pinned crypto: Ed25519 seed 000102..1f -> privkey/pubkey (schnorr48 reference impl), origin_ipv6 = upstream AddrForKey(pubkey) 02062f7c200618f7a0f14791738c5a1f, canonical-CBOR SOS payload, real SHA-512 transcript digest, real 48-byte Schnorr48 signature. Independent oracle: Python reference impl generated all bytes; Rust lichen-link cross-verified (valid sig verifies, DAO-domain sig rejected, wrong origin addr rejected, deterministic re-sign reproduces) before landing. Pinned anchor in origin_signature.pinned_vector; sos_valid_signature_accept, sos_wrong_key_signature_drop, wrong_domain_rejected now carry real values (wrong-domain = real LICHEN-DAO-ORIGIN-v1 signature). Verified: Python consumers 94/94, Rust sos_origin_vectors 2/2, schema-policy 1/1, JSON valid. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge, kimi-k3): 2 data-consistency findings (conflicting sender_iid placeholder, stale claimed_pubkey placeholder) fixed inline and filed as P3 beads; crypto independently re-derived and verified by the security reviewer. Note: b7z9.121 parent has all 5 children closed after this.
